_readme: Weekly feed for The Field Reader (/tools-field-reader).
TO UPDATE FOR A NEW TOURNAMENT — edit `event`, then replace `players`.
event.surface must be one of: bentgrass, bermuda, poa.
event.profile values are 0-100 and set where the sliders START. They are
the course's demands, not a player's skill: distance 85 means the course
rewards length heavily.
PLAYERS. Every skill is 0-100 where 50 is a tour-average player.
`putting` is split by surface because a good Bermuda putter is not
automatically a good Poa putter.
The shipped list is ARCHETYPES, not real golfers, and every entry is
flagged `"archetype": true`. They exist so the model is usable and
testable before anyone sources a real field.
If you add real players, set `"archetype": false` and use REAL numbers,
converted from a public source you can point at — PGA Tour strokes-gained
stats (SG: Off-the-Tee, SG: Approach, SG: Around-the-Green, SG: Putting)
rescaled to 0-100. Do not estimate them by feel. Publishing invented
statistics about a named person is not a modelling shortcut, it is a
false claim about someone real, and the page carries a byline.
The tool validates this file on load and refuses to render a field that
does not parse, rather than showing a half-built board.

event.name: Sample Signature Event
event.readTheCourse: A long par 71 where the second shot decides everything. Length gets you a wedge instead of a 7-iron, but the greens are small enough that approach play, not raw distance, separates the field. Bentgrass surfaces roll true, which slightly flattens the putting edge.

players.name: The Bomber
players.note: Overpowers a course when the rough is soft and the greens are big.

players.name: The Iron Surgeon
players.note: Hits it to fifteen feet from anywhere and never needs to scramble.

players.name: The Grinder
players.note: Misses greens all week and still shoots 69. Lives on the short game.

players.name: The Flat-Stick Savant
players.note: Wins by making everything inside twelve feet, loses when the putts stop.

players.name: The Complete Player
players.note: No weakness anywhere, which is why the price is never any good.

players.name: The Wild Long Hitter
players.note: Two feast weeks and eight missed cuts. The rough length decides which.

players.name: The Fairway Metronome
players.note: Finds every fairway and every green, and never makes a birdie run.

players.name: The Bermuda Specialist
players.note: Transformed on Bermuda greens, ordinary on anything else.

players.name: The Poa Reader
players.note: Grew up on bumpy afternoon Poa and stops caring when it gets late.

players.name: The Short-Game Escape Artist
players.note: Up and down from the car park. Needs a course that forgives the long game.

players.name: The Young Athlete
players.note: Length and iron play arriving together, short game still catching up.

players.name: The Veteran Plodder
players.note: Gives up forty yards a drive and beats half the field on know-how.
